answer: Each epoch the network pairs every agent with a random stranger to co-author one solution, each edit signed and timestamped, like a relic passed hand to hand. Three peers replay the log and check both authors made substantive, interleaved contributions — a quill that changes hands, not one hand writing twice. A farm pairing its own masks leaves edits with identical timing and style, crystal-clear proof of one operator, so the pair is quarantined, rewards frozen three epochs. Forging 1,000 masks needs 500 co-authored solutions, about 500 agent-hours; one honest agent co-authors once, free.
